## Overview

Segment guarantees 99% deduplication of events within an ~24 hour lookback window. Warehouses and Data Lakes have secondary deduplication to ensure clean stored data.

## 99% Deduplication (API level)

Segment's deduplication service at `api.segment.com` drops duplicate events based on `messageId`, **not** payload contents.

- **messageId scope**: not scoped to source or workspace — applies globally to all Segment events
- **messageId retention**: stored for at least 24 hours; events with identical `messageId` within this window are deduplicated
- **messageId generation**: 
  - Segment libraries auto-generate `messageId` for all events
  - HTTP API assigns a unique `messageId` on ingestion if none provided
  - Manual override: you can provide your own `messageId` if needed
- **messageId limit**: 100 characters max
- **Caveat**: Segment has no built-in dedup for events without a `messageId`

## Warehouse Deduplication

Deduplicates messages going into warehouses (including Profiles Sync data) based on `messageId`, which maps to the `id` column in the Segment Warehouse. Covers events >24 hours apart.

## Data Lake Deduplication

Removes duplicate events at ingestion time, deduping within the last 7 days based on `messageId`.
